title: Shreibman family of Sokółka
summary: A provisional family grouping is supported for Meir Shreibman, his wife Dabeh, and their sons Gabriel and Reuben. Dorah and Itzkeh Shreibman should not be included as immediate family members without additional evidence.
editorialContent:
**Members:** Meir Shreibman; Dabeh Shreibman; Gabriel Shreibman; Reuben Shreibman.

The Sokółka necrology index explicitly identifies Dabeh as Meir’s wife and Gabriel and Reuben as his sons. Other Shreibman entries are recorded separately pending confirmation.
